scenes.narrationText: 60.8 grams of fat. Saturated fat is 4.5 grams, which is reasonably controlled for a high-fat nut. Omega 3 is 90 milligrams, so it is not doing much for omega 3 support. Polyunsaturated fat is 7.9 grams, another weaker fat-quality mark. For nuts, the fat section matters because most of the calories are coming from fat.

scenes.narrationText: Magnesium is 41% daily value, the best mineral here and useful for muscle, nerve, and energy-metabolism support. Iron is 26% daily value, a decent blood-and-oxygen mark. Zinc is 18% daily value, present but not strong enough to make immune support a headline. For nuts, minerals help justify the dense calorie package, and hazelnuts are good but not elite here.
